rows.actual: With rho=rho_(Lambda,h), the bond tail W_L and its gradient over both endpoints are polynomial factors supported on max(|q_x|,|q_y|)>L. Prove the Dirichlet identity first for a bounded outer truncation W_(L,M) on the common core and pass M to infinity by exponential domination. Then ||W_L||_D^2 and ||[log rho,W_L]||_D^2=(beta hbar^2/chi)phi(|grad_(x,y) W_L|^2) are at most C_(a,N)L^N exp(-aL^2) for arbitrary a>0.
rows.name: modular identity authority

rows.actual: EXP-000781 instantiates Kozitsky--Pasurek Theorems 3.1--3.3 for exact Q3LOCK. For a periodic finite volume define A_x=lambda_sigma||omega_x||_(C^sigma)^2+kappa||omega_x||_2^2. Condition the periodic law at x, apply their Lemma 4.1, integrate, and use generalized Holder with r_y=theta|J^Lambda_xy|/kappa and sum_y r_y<1. Finite-volume integrability then gives exp(n_x)<=exp(C)prod_y exp(r_y n_y), hence the conditional moment recursion n_x<=C+(theta/kappa)sum_y|J^Lambda_xy|n_y. Translation invariance, Jhat_Lambda<=6c, and kappa>theta Jhat_Lambda give n<=C/(1-theta Jhat_Lambda/kappa), uniformly in periodic volume and compact source by the EXP-000781 stability constants. Its arbitrary L2 exponential coefficient plus Holder control and the point-evaluation inequality imply sup phi(exp[a|q_x(0)|^2])<infinity for every a>0 at fixed beta.
rows.name: periodic recursion authority
